description: A team plans projects as tasks, where some tasks must wait for others.

entities.name: Project
entities.description: A piece of work made of tasks.

fields.name: archived
fields.description: false until the project is archived

fields.name: blocked_by_id
fields.description: the id of the task that must be done before this one can start

endpoints.summary: Add a task to a project

rules: A new project has archived false. A new task has status todo.
A task cannot be added to an archived project; reject with 409.
blocked_by_id, when sent, must refer to an existing task (otherwise 404) that is in the same project (otherwise 422).
start moves a task from todo to doing; finish moves it from doing to done. Any other status change returns 409.
A task with a blocked_by_id cannot be started until that task has status done; starting it earlier returns 409.
A task that another task is blocked by cannot be deleted; reject with 409.
archive sets archived to true. A project can be archived only when it has at least one task and every task is done; otherwise 409. Archiving a project that is already archived returns 409.

GET /projects/{id}/progress returns a JSON object with project_id, total (number of tasks), done (number with status done) and percent (done x 100 / total rounded to the nearest whole number, 0 when there are no tasks). An unknown project returns 404.
project_id must refer to an existing project; otherwise 404.
